The translucent whites and pearlescent creams of the fossil structure create an ethereal, crystalline environment where each chamber is defined by its own architectural form. Through subtle camera rotation that responds to mouse movement, viewers can explore the granular internal landscape, observing how accretions pulse with organic rhythm, revealing the dynamic nature of mineral deposition within ancient biological structures.
